phrase: An AI tool claims to diagnose better than doctors. Nearby, towns are fighting data centers over felled forests and drained water.
phraseAlternatives: One AI claims to out-diagnose doctors. The towns near its rivals' data centers are losing trees and water.
A new AI tool says it beats doctors at hard diagnoses. Meanwhile, data centers are draining wells and felling forests nearby.
AI promises sharper diagnoses than doctors give. The land feeding its data centers tells a thirstier story.
An AI system claims to diagnose better than doctors can. Outside its data centers, forests are gone and wells are dry.
alt: A proud robot doctor raises its arms beside a bar chart with a tall highlighted bar, while a worried human doctor shrugs beside the chart's shorter bar. Behind them, through a window, a datacenter sits on a hillside of tree stumps on one side and a dry well with a small red protest flag on the other.

brief.concept: A robot doctor proudly holds up a diagnosis chart with a taller bar than a human doctor's, while through a window behind them a small datacenter sits on a hillside of tree stumps beside a dry well.
brief.metaphor: The diagnosis chart rises like a boast; the stumps and the dry well are the quiet bill behind it.
